claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is not damage, movement, condition, spell access, or item-form change. It creates a persistent adhesive bond between two objects that survives until a narrow set of named breakers is applied.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Non-spell activations currently hardcode trace context to Self. Sovereign Glue targets object surfaces being coated, so an honest encoding needs a non-spell targeting/range header such as Touch rather than a misleading self-only application.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.rolled
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's stock is instance-variable rather than fixed. A generic Sovereign Glue record needs to express that found containers begin with a rolled quantity instead of a fixed use cap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.
